scope: Offline fixes for the generation failures documented on 14–15 October

fixes.problem: Known output truncation terminated the legacy agent
fixes.result: Confirmed HTTP 200 length is a separate control step. Partial actions are discarded; the next request asks for a smaller complete change. Three truncations without source progress stop the loop; an earlier green build cannot authorize completion.

fixes.problem: Missing local flower.css did not enter source repair
fixes.result: A completed frozen-source full build can admit local source or asset import repair. Wrong identity, infrastructure failures, package imports, sensitive paths and traversal outside the workspace remain excluded. Repair is followed by a new build; no-op repair does not buy another build.

fixes.problem: Ambiguous native HTTP or transport failures could replay a paid request
fixes.result: Unknown HTTP 502/503/504, WriteTimeout and RemoteProtocolError are terminal without replay. Preconnect retries require either a direct pre-dispatch failure or the gateway's strict post-journal llmgw_preconnect_v1 proof. The existing closed 429 contract is preserved.

fixes.problem: The report lacked finish metadata and an unclassified 429 implied a frequency limit
fixes.result: Allowlisted finish_reason, requested_max_tokens and completion_tokens survive progress persistence. Unclassified HTTP 429 has neutral diagnostics; only a verified category identifies rate limiting.

verification.independent_review: No remaining actionable findings after the importer-path correction

real_next_fixture.scope: Synthetic local fixture; not a generated customer application or live product acceptance

provider_default_output_followup.user_decision: Delegate the automatic per-response Sonnet 5.5 output budget to LLMGW
provider_default_output_followup.behavior: For exact Sonnet 5.5 IDs, an automatic budget is omitted from the final provider JSON. Explicit budgets and other model defaults remain unchanged. No claim that omission chooses the provider maximum or removes its limits.
provider_default_output_followup.safety: Native wallet estimation retains its former estimate independently of the sent budget. Cache keys distinguish the new automatic policy. Truncated actions are rejected; ambiguous paid POSTs are not replayed.
provider_default_output_followup.offline_verification: 331 focused API checks; full gateway suite plus added wallet refusal checks; affected-file Ruff and Linux-target API mypy. Complete API and real PostgreSQL contracts require exact-revision Linux CI.
provider_default_output_followup.live_provider_acceptance: Not performed; only free catalog GETs and mocked final-wire assertions. Provider defaults, rejection behavior and long-response latency remain unverified.
